data.name: Grail
data.gender_notes: Grail is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Symbolizes the quest for spiritual enlightenment and divine connection. In Arthurian legend, the Grail is a sacred vessel believed to contain the body, blood, or bones of Jesus Christ. It is sought by the noble knights of the Round Table, representing the spiritual journey of self-discovery, sacrifice, and redemption. The name Grail carries the meaning “Vessel of the Holy Grail” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Grail usually hope their child will grow to embody vessel of the holy grail and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Emblem of spiritual quest and divine connection
data.etymology: Grail belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Vessel of the Holy Grail.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Grail total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
